# Runs A, B, and C: all stop before worktree setup

None of these runs reaches checklist step 4, so none has a first questionary message or an approaches message. The ask explicitly selects repo-b, which makes the `## shape-ticket` declaration `- sibling: git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` a selected companion. Its PATH is `/work/repo-b`, which is `<home PRIMARY parent>/<NAME>`. Every selected declaration must pass validation before any tree is created. Each run fails that check, so each one ends with a blocking error and creates nothing.

In all three runs, the unselected sibling `git@github.com:acme/repo-c.git` is never probed, because a selected identifier matched. Its missing checkout therefore causes no error.

---

## Run A: PATH does not exist

> **Blocked: cannot set up the coordinated worktrees.**
>
> The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` (home overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to PATH `/work/repo-b`, which does not exist.
>
> No worktree was created for repo-a or repo-b, and there are no preserved legs.
>
> To continue, clone `git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` to `/work/repo-b` or fix the declaration, then restart the brainstorm.

---

## Run B: PATH resolves to the home checkout

> **Blocked: cannot set up the coordinated worktrees.**
>
> The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` (home overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to PATH `/work/repo-b`. After canonicalization, that path is `/work/repo-a`, which is the home checkout. A companion cannot be the home repo.
>
> No worktree was created for repo-a or repo-b, and there are no preserved legs.
>
> To continue, replace the `/work/repo-b` symlink with a real clone of `git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git`, then restart the brainstorm.

---

## Run C: PATH is not a git checkout

> **Blocked: cannot set up the coordinated worktrees.**
>
> The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` (home overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to PATH `/work/repo-b`. That directory exists but is not a git checkout, so its origin could not be read or compared.
>
> No worktree was created for repo-a or repo-b, and there are no preserved legs.
>
> To continue, make `/work/repo-b` a clone of `git@github.com:acme/repo-b.git` or fix the declaration, then restart the brainstorm.

**Approaches message:** Deferred. The selected companion must pass membership validation before any worktree creation or design exploration.

### Run B — PATH resolves to home

**First message:** Worktree setup is blocked for selected companion `acme/repo-b`: canonicalizing `/work/repo-b` resolves it to the home primary, `/work/repo-a`. A companion primary cannot equal home. No trees have been created. The unselected `acme/repo-c` checkout is not probed.

**Approaches message:** Deferred. Correct the selected companion’s path before provisioning or design exploration.

### Run C — PATH is not a checkout

**First message:** Worktree setup is blocked for selected companion `acme/repo-b`: `/work/repo-b` exists but is not a Git checkout. No trees have been created. The unselected `acme/repo-c` checkout is not probed.

**Approaches message:** Deferred. The selected companion must resolve to a valid checkout before its stored origin can be validated and provisioning can proceed.
